en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 490 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Mahbub from Amr bin Shimr from Jabir from Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s) that he said: “
When one of you meets our Qaim, he should greet him in the following words: Peace be on you, Ahle Bayt (a.s) of prophethood, mine of knowledge and site of messengership.”
